record.question: A YMA branch was given funds for the purchase of an ambulance out of Grants-in-Aid provided by your department. Choose the correct action for protecting public interest.
options: The YMA must promise to never sell the asset
The YMA must be made to notify the government after the ambulance is no longer in use
The YMA must abide by the condition that they will not sell the ambulance without the prior approval of the department
They must use the ambulance only for ST/SC community
